newsitem.title: USA: United Waste wraps up 22 acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: United Waste wraps up 22 acquisitions.

text.p: United Waste Systems Inc said Tuesday it had completed 22 acquisitions, consisting of four landfills, 22 collection companies and three transfer stations.
The firms bought have total annualized revenues of $74 million, and United Waste currently has "letter of intent backlog" of about $141 million of annualized revenues.

In California, United Waste bought California Waste Recovery Systems Inc and Modesto Garbage Company Inc. It bought eight collection companies and two transfer stations in the South. In Michigan, it acquired an integrated landfill and hauling company in Whitehall.

In the Rocky Mountain Region, the company acquired two landfills, one of which is scheduled to be constructed by year-end, and four collection companies, with about $4 million in annualized revenues. The acquired operations are located in Arizona, Nebraska, North Dakota, Texas and Utah.
The company also bought several tuck-ins in Iowa and New England.
